en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a studio scene of four people in traditional dress labeled as Jewish costumes from Salonica: three women wearing long dresses, aprons, and headscarves stand around a seated man in Ottoman-style attire with a fez. The photo is bordered by a printed caption in French at the bottom and publisher credit along the left edge. The right half of the card is densely filled with handwritten text in Greek, including a date in 1904.
